rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on rental property owners using a coordinator's services
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a rental property owner or its agent, representative or subcontractor to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or exchange consideration for the services of a coordinator (a person operating algorithmic revenue management software or an algorithmic device that performs a coordinating function).
rules.coverage_text: Rental property owners (owning one or more residential dwelling units) and their agents, representatives and subcontractors in New Jersey.

exemption_tests.description: Residential dwelling unit excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.

Coordinating function excludes research/statistical analysis not used in setting rents, free public rent estimates, equal-terms real estate brokerage databases that do not set or recommend rents, and government entities setting rents through affordability controls.

rules.exemptions_text: Coordinating function excludes research/statistical/testing use, free public rent estimates, certain brokerage databases, and government affordability controls; residential dwelling unit excludes inpatient medical, long-term care and detention facilities.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator;
rules.ambiguity_note: Effective on the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (approved July 20, 2026); exact calendar date not stated in text.

rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on coordinators facilitating anticompetitive agreements
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a coordinator to facilitate a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners that restricts competition for residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function.
rules.coverage_text: Coordinators (operators of algorithmic revenue management software or algorithmic devices performing a coordinating function), including owners doing so for their own benefit.

exemption_tests.description: Government entity setting or limiting rents through affordability controls is not a coordinator.

rules.exemptions_text: Government entities setting rents via affordability controls are not coordinators.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: a coordinator to facilitate a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners that restricts competition with respect to residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function;
rules.ambiguity_note: Effective on the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (approved July 20, 2026); exact calendar date not stated in text.

rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on parallel pricing coordination
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for two or more persons to engage in or otherwise facilitate parallel pricing coordination, meaning a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners to raise, change, maintain or manipulate pricing for interchangeable units.
rules.coverage_text: Any persons engaging in or facilitating parallel pricing coordination for residential dwelling units.

exemption_tests.description: Pricing required by affordability controls is not parallel pricing coordination.

rules.exemptions_text: Conduct required under affordability controls is excluded from parallel pricing coordination.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: two or more persons to engage in
rules.ambiguity_note: Quoted span is truncated by a footnote marker in the text; effective on first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (July 20, 2026).

rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on coordinator agents engaging in parallel pricing coordination
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any agent or representative of a coordinator, or a subcontractor thereof, to engage in parallel pricing coordination.
rules.coverage_text: Agents, representatives and subcontractors of coordinators.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: any agent or representative of a coordinator or subcontractor thereof to engage in parallel pricing coordination;
rules.ambiguity_note: Effective on the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (approved July 20, 2026); exact calendar date not stated in text.

rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on performing a coordinating function
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any person to perform a coordinating function, i.e., use algorithms or automated processes on competitively sensitive information of rental property owners to set or recommend rental prices, material lease terms or occupancy levels.
rules.coverage_text: Any person performing a coordinating function with respect to residential dwelling units.

exemption_tests.description: Excludes research/statistical analysis not used to set rents, free public rent estimates, equal-terms brokerage databases that do not set rents, and government affordability controls.

rules.exemptions_text: Coordinating function does not include research/statistical/testing use, free public rent estimates, certain real estate brokerage databases, or government affordability controls.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: any person to perform a coordinating function.
rules.ambiguity_note: Effective on the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (approved July 20, 2026); exact calendar date not stated in text.
